The package installs only the intended binary under `/usr/bin`, with no post-install hooks or system modifications.

All operations align with standard AUR packaging practices. The source is from the declared upstream, the checksum is provided, and the installation is minimal and transparent. There is no evidence of injected malicious code, data exfiltration, or supply-chain attacks.
